title: Spicy Springy Ramen
description: A quick and easy Korean-inspired ramen recipe with a spicy kick.
instructions: Bring ramen broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add springy noodles and cook according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together chili flakes, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Add the spice mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Garnish with green onions and sliced green chilies.
Optional: add sliced protein (e.g., chicken, beef, or tofu) for added protein.
Optional: customize with additional toppings (e.g., kimchi, bean sprouts, or pickled ginger).
